patterns_found.evidence: Prior bearish structure with lower lows from 67000 down to ~62200. Price then established a higher low at ~64200 and broke above the previous swing high at ~65500, shifting market structure to bullish.

patterns_found.evidence: Head low visible at ~62200. Right shoulder formation near 64000-64500. Price breaking above the neckline area around 65000-65500.

patterns_found.name: Bullish Flag
patterns_found.evidence: Strong impulsive advance from ~62200 to ~65500 followed by a shallow consolidation/pullback toward 64200-65000, with price now testing the upper boundary.
